title: Switching to `WINDOW_MODE_FULLSCREEN` in-game does not work on Wayland (Hyprland)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3-stable, 4.4.1-stable, 4.5.2-stable, 4.6.3-stable, 4.7-stable, 4.7.1-stable, 4.8-dev1
- Not reproducible before 4.3 (no Wayland support)

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Arch Linux (Hyprland) - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+)

### Issue description

If project setting `display/display_server/driver.linuxbsd` is default or X11, fullscreen works as expected.
If set to Wayland, making the game window start fullscreen in project settings works, but setting it to `WINDOW_MODE_FULLSCREEN` at runtime only maximizes the window.
This may be a Hyprland issue, but considering fullscreen in project settings works and other windows are able to fullscreen at any time I think it is more likely to be a Godot issue, though setting fullscreen through project settings appears to call the same function as you would in-game.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. Set `display/display_server/driver.linuxbsd` to `wayland`
3. Observe that setting `display/window/size/mode` to Fullscreen works as expected and set back to Windowed
4. Create a scene with a script that calls `DisplayServer.window_set_mode(DisplayServer.WINDOW_MODE_FULLSCREEN)`
5. Observe that window only maximizes when the script runs

N/A
